profile: Altimmune is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing pemvidutide, an investigational balanced glucagon/GLP-1 dual-receptor agonist. The candidate is being studied for metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease. Its pipeline includes a global Phase 3 MASH trial, results from a completed Phase 2 alcohol-use-disorder study, and an ongoing Phase 2 study in alcohol-associated liver disease.
